input.prompt:
You are a fork building ONE part of the Sounding frontend. Write only these files: /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/Insights.jsx and /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/Settings.jsx (replace the stubs), plus /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/insights.css (import from both). Do not edit any other file. Do not deploy, restart services, or touch the GPU box.

Use helpers from ../api.js (get/post/patch/put/del/useApi/qs) and ../ui.jsx (Modal, Menu, Tabs, Field, Spinner, Loading, ErrorNote, Empty, PageHead, Avatar, fmtClock, fmtDate, fmtDay, fmtAgo, copyText, absLink, go, setQuery, useApp, useAction). The API is exactly the backend in /root/fathom-clone/server/sounding/routes (read intel.py, org.py, account.py, api_v1.py for shapes). useApp() gives { me, org, teams, isAdmin, isLead, members, reloadMembers, refreshMe, toast }.

Insights.jsx exports:
- `TrackersPage()`: GET /trackers; list name, kind (Keyword / AI), keywords or description, hits and meetings in last 30 days, "Scanning past meetings" when pending (poll every 4s while any pending), subscribe toggle (POST/DELETE /trackers/{id}/subscribe), edit/delete for can_edit. Create/edit modal: name, type radio (Keywords: comma-separated keywords, exact match; AI: a description of the moments to find, matched by meaning), explain subscribers get a notification when it comes up.
- `TrackerPage({ id })`: find the tracker from GET /trackers; GET /trackers/{id}/hits?days= with 30/90/365 filter; group by meeting (title, date) with quotes and timestamp links to #/meeting/{mid}?t={t}. A tiny weekly count bar chart of hits is welcome (simple inline SVG or CSS bars, accessible labels, no chart library).
- `CoachingPage()`: tabs "Talk metrics" and "Scorecards". Talk metrics: GET /coaching?days=&team_id= with 7/30/90 filter and team filter (teams from GET /org/teams, only shown if isAdmin or isLead); table: person, meetings, talk %, words per minute, questions per call, longest monologue (fmtClock), monologues; explain metrics only count meetings where a speaker was linked to that teammate on the meeting page, and what a healthy talk ratio looks like for sales discovery (roughly 40-60%) in one plain sentence. Scorecards: GET /coaching/scorecards; for each scorecard: name, meeting type, average score, per-criterion averages (bars), top performers and everyone else, recent scored meetings linked. Non-admin members see only themselves (API already filters); say so.
- `AskPage()`: account-wide Ask. Scope select: All calls I can see / My calls / Teammates' calls (scope all/mine/team). Chat thread; POST /ask {question, scope}; show "Searched N meetings"; turn citations like [M3 12:34] or [M3 1:02:03] or [M3] into links using the refs map (#/meeting/{id}?t=seconds) showing the meeting title on hover/aria-label; suggestion chips ("What objections came up this month?", "Summarize what customers asked for", "What did we promise to send, and to whom?"). If query.q in the hash (use parseHash from ../ui.jsx) prefill and auto-ask once.

Settings.jsx exports:
- `SettingsPage()`: sections: Profile (name; change password with current/new/confirm; PATCH /me then refreshMe()), Notes (default template select from GET /templates; custom instructions textarea explained as "Added to every summary Sounding writes for your meetings"; PATCH /me {settings}), API keys (list GET /me/api-keys; create modal with name → show the key once with Copy and a warning it won't be shown again; delete), Webhooks (list with last_status; create with URL and include checkboxes summary/action items/transcript → show secret once; Send test; delete; explain the X-Sounding-Signature header is HMAC-SHA256 of the body with the secret). Also a short "Using the API" block with a curl example against `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/meetings` using header X-Api-Key.
- `AdminPage({ section })`: only for isAdmin (others see a plain message). Left sub-nav with links #/admin/members, teams, meeting-types, templates, scorecards, dictionary, organization. Members: GET /org/members table (name, email, role select admin/member, teams, active toggle deactivate/reactivate via PATCH /org/members/{id}); "Invite people" modal (optional email, role, optional team) → show the invite link absLink('#/invite/'+token) with Copy and explain it works once and expires in 14 days since email isn't set up; pending invites list with revoke. Teams: list GET /org/teams with members; create/rename/delete; add member (select from members) with "Team lead" checkbox; remove; toggle lead. Meeting types: CRUD (name, description used for automatic detection, default notes template select from GET /templates). Templates: CRUD custom templates (name, base template select from built-ins, instructions); show built-ins read-only with their sections. Scorecards: CRUD (name, meeting type select, criteria editor rows name + description, add/remove, 1–12); explain scoring runs on that meeting type's calls and scores the meeting owner. Dictionary: editable list of up to 50 terms (each ≤6 words, ≤100 chars) with client-side validation; PATCH /org/settings {dictionary}. Organization: rename org (PATCH /org/settings {name}).

Responsive at 390px without horizontal overflow; tables scroll horizontally inside their own wrapper; visible focus; aria labels on icon buttons. Style: follow /root/fathom-clone/src/styles.css tokens/classes; prefix new classes with `in-`. Writing: sentence case, plain verbs, buttons say what they do, errors explain how to fix; no all-caps labels, no emoji. Never log or print secrets (API keys/webhook secrets are only rendered in the UI once).

Verify with: cd /root/fathom-clone && npx vite build --outDir /tmp/claude-0/-root/a2db516c-9100-4760-bff1-2f9fe28ddb93/scratchpad/build-insights (must succeed; other pages may still be stubs). Then report what you implemented, anything skipped, and backend gaps you noticed (don't fix backend yourself).

I built the trackers, coaching, Ask, settings and admin pages as asked. They compile, but I haven't run any of them in a browser or against the live API.

The full app build currently fails at `src/pages/Meeting.jsx`, which imports `./meeting.css`. That file belongs to the meeting-page helper and doesn't exist yet. My two pages compile cleanly when built on their own through the Vite API, with a temporary entry point in the scratchpad.

**Insights.jsx**
- **`TrackersPage`:** lists trackers with their type, keywords or description, and mentions and meetings over the last 30 days. It shows "Scanning past meetings" and polls every 4 seconds while a scan is running. People can subscribe or unsubscribe. Whoever can edit a tracker gets edit and delete. The create and edit dialog offers keywords or AI matching and explains that subscribers get notifications.
- **`TrackerPage`:** time filter of 30, 90 or 365 days, and a weekly bar chart with an accessible label. Mentions are grouped by meeting, each with a quote and a timestamp link (`#/meeting/{id}?t=`). Matches reload when a background scan finishes.
- **`CoachingPage`:**
  - **Talk metrics tab:** filters for 7, 30 or 90 days, and a team filter shown only to admins and team leads. The table has the seven columns you asked for. A note explains that only meetings with a speaker linked to the teammate count, that 40–60% talk time is typical for sales discovery, and that members only see their own numbers.
  - **Scorecards tab:** average score, bars per criterion, top performers and everyone else, and recent scored meetings.
- **`AskPage`:** scope choice (all, mine, teammates'), suggestion chips, and "Searched N meetings". Citations such as `[M3 12:34]`, `[M3 1:02:03]` and `[M3]` become links that seek to the moment. It pre-fills and asks once when the page opens with `?q=` in the URL.

**Settings.jsx**
- **`SettingsPage`:**
  - Profile: name and password change, then refreshes the signed-in user.
  - Notes: default template and custom instructions.
  - API keys: the key is shown once with a Copy button and a warning.
  - Webhooks: include checkboxes, the signing secret shown once, Send test, delete, and an explanation of how the signature header works.
  - A curl example for the API.
- **`AdminPage`:** non-admins get a plain message. There's a sub-menu with seven sections:
  - Members: role, deactivate and reactivate, invite dialog that shows the link once, pending invites with revoke.
  - Teams: create, rename, delete, add and remove members, team lead toggle.
  - Meeting types: create, edit, delete.
  - Templates: custom ones editable, built-in ones read-only with their sections.
  - Scorecards: criteria editor with 1–12 rows.
  - Dictionary: 50 terms, 6 words and 100 characters each, with invalid ones marked red.
  - Organization: rename.

**insights.css**
All classes start with `in-`. Tables scroll inside their own container, and the layouts collapse to one column below 900 px.

**Not done**
- Renaming a team uses the browser's `prompt()` rather than a styled dialog.
- The coaching team filter lists every organization team, including ones a team lead doesn't lead. The API still limits the numbers they see.

**Backend gaps I noticed (not fixed)**
- `/coaching/scorecards` returns `recent.user` as a plain name, not an object with an id.
- `GET /org/teams` and `GET /org/scorecards` are open to any member, which is fine for reading.
- Nothing lets a team lead list only the teams they lead.
- `PATCH /api/org/settings` returns only the name and dictionary, so I call `refreshMe()` afterwards to update the organization name in the app header.

No commits were made.
